title: Why can't I edit my scheduled payment?
summary: Explains that scheduled payments can’t be edited within 13 hours of the scheduled time; during this lock window, you can’t change amount, date, or cadence. If you’re within the window, wait for the occurrence to process and then edit future occurrences, or cancel to prevent future payments.
